profiles.description: Local stdio execution over explicitly allowed image roots with deterministic image operations and local OCR.

identity.trustBoundary: The invoking local user, the configured image roots, and that user's operating-system permissions.

authorization.scope: Read access is limited to absolute roots explicitly listed in VISION_ALLOWED_ROOTS.

lifecycle.freshness: Each invocation opens and validates the selected image from its allowed root.
lifecycle.cleanup: Source images are unchanged; ephemeral worker scratch and default artifacts are removed at application shutdown.

notReady.reason: No valid allowed image root or required Python image dependency is available.

mutation.authorization: Platform mutation policy must explicitly enable principal-scoped diff and optimized-image artifact creation.
mutation.confirmation: Platform confirmation policy applies before compare_images or optimize_image_region can create an artifact.
mutation.authoritativeVerification: A successful result returns an opaque artifact identifier that the same principal can read until application cleanup.

profiles.description: Local stdio execution with bounded filesystem images and explicitly configured Azure Content Understanding OCR.

providerPrerequisites.description: An HTTPS Azure AI Content Understanding endpoint and an Entra application authorized only for analysis.

identity.trustBoundary: The invoking local user, configured image roots, and the explicitly forwarded Azure service-principal credential.
rbac: Cognitive Services User on the selected Azure AI resource

authorization.scope: Read access is limited to absolute roots explicitly listed in VISION_ALLOWED_ROOTS.

lifecycle.freshness: Each invocation validates the local image before a selected OCR request is sent.
lifecycle.cleanup: Source images are unchanged; worker scratch is removed at shutdown and provider retention follows the operator's Azure policy.

notReady.reason: Allowed roots, Python dependencies, provider endpoint, or explicit provider identity configuration are absent.

mutation.authorization: Platform mutation policy must explicitly enable principal-scoped diff and optimized-image artifact creation.
mutation.confirmation: Platform confirmation policy applies before compare_images or optimize_image_region can create an artifact.
mutation.authoritativeVerification: A successful result returns an opaque artifact identifier that the same principal can read until application cleanup.
